products.title: Casio Edifice EFR-539D-1AVUDF Analog Black Dial Men Watch
products.short_description: A powerful Casio Edifice chronograph featuring a multi-dimensional layered face design, 100-meter water resistance, and a sturdy stainless steel build.
products.long_description: The Casio Edifice EFR-539D-1AVUDF (EX191) is a high-performance analog watch inspired by the world of motor racing. It features a sophisticated multidimensional watch face with layered sub-dials and hour markers that provide a deep, aesthetic look. The watch is constructed with a durable stainless steel case and band, housing a precise quartz movement with a 1/10-second stopwatch. With 100-meter water resistance, it is built to handle both professional environments and outdoor adventures like snorkeling or swimming.
